subject: POC qualification follow-up: scope, owners, procurement path
content:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@novacorp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC qualification follow-up: scope, owners, procurement path

Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Notes below are a quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the trial/POC plan and get procurement moving. Please correct anything I missed.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for NovaCorp's customer-facing semantic search (latency target <= 200ms p95 for 512-token queries) and embeddings for catalog similarity.
- Success criteria: p95 latency under 200ms at 50 RPS sustained (baseline queries attached), embedding cosine recall >= 0.88 on your evaluation set, and no sensitive-data retention beyond session scope.
- Scope: 2-week sandbox trial against a subset of the product catalog (approx 500k items), one API integration path (backend inference calls), and shared eval prompt set.

Proposed owners (first pass)
- Redwood infra / trial provisioning: Kimberly Park (redwood dedicated/private onramp)
- Redwood integration & support lead: Aditya Rao (day-to-day RMS contact)
- Customer app/tuning owner: Alex Green (NovaCorp engineering)
- Customer security & legal contact: NovaCorp Procurement (cc'd) + point SOC2 contact (we'll share our summary)
- CSM / success: Monica Patel (enablement, runbook, acceptance)

Procurement/contracting ask
- A 30-day evaluation MSA + one-week trial order form is sufficient for start. Procurement asked about data handling and audit logs — Kimberly, can you attach the short security summary (SOC2 + retention)?

Attachments: poc_scope.xlsx (proposed inventory & test plan), redwood_security_summary.pdf (SOC2 highlights)

Next steps (owner + ETA)
- Kimberly: confirm environment type (hosted vs dedicated sandbox) and provide estimate for provision time — EOD Thu 5/28
- Monica: share onboarding runbook + test harness and set 30-minute kickoff once infra is live — target Fri 5/29
- Alex: confirm list of 3 representative queries and procurement contact email for PO — EOD Wed 5/27
- Aditya: draft mutual action plan and trial timeline + send to all — Tue 5/26 (this email)

Thanks — I’ll follow up on infra ETA and loop in procurement details once Kimberly confirms.

—
Aditya Rao
Business Development, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Green <alex.green@novacorp.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC qualification follow-up: scope, owners, procurement path

Aditya — thanks for the recap and the quick turnaround. Confirming the three items from our side:
1) We can carve out a 500k-item subset and share the representative query set by EOD 5/27.
2) Procurement wants an abbreviated SOW and an invoice template — I’ll share procurement contact: procurement@novacorp.com.
3) Security: we’ll need the SOC2 short summary and a declaration on data retention for the trial (no PHI/PII to be stored).

Assume we’ll run hosted sandbox unless Kimberly flags a reason to go dedicated. Can you include an estimated cost ballpark if we required a dedicated 2-week environment? That would help procurement evaluate.

—Alex
Alex Green
Senior Manager, Search Engineering — NovaCorp
alex.green@novacorp.com | +1 (617) 555-8891

On Wed, 27 May 2026 at 12:38 PM, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com> wrote:
> From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
> To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
> Cc: Alex Green <alex.green@novacorp.com>
> Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 12:38:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: POC qualification follow-up: scope, owners, procurement path
>
> Thanks — quick infra notes from my side:
> - Hosted sandbox (fastest): we can provision a scoped hosted environment today, shared across sessions, with built-in KV/prefix caching. Provision time: ~1 business day.
> - Dedicated sandbox (recommended for true latency isolation): requires a small reserved pool (1 A100 equivalent) and takes ~3 business days plus a brief security checklist. Estimated list price for 2 weeks dedicated trial: $6,500 — I’ll provide a line-item breakdown if procurement asks.
> - Security artifact (attached): redwood_security_summary.pdf includes SOC2 scope, retention defaults, and audit log excerpts. For the trial we set retention to 7 days by default; can confirm shorter windows if you need.
>
> RACI (first pass) — simple single-line mapping for kickoff:
> - Customer: App integration & test harness (Alex Green)
> - Redwood: Provisioning & infra ops (Kimberly Park)
> - Redwood: Trial cadence, eval metrics, and acceptance (Monica Patel)
> - Sales: commercial touchpoint & timelines (Aditya Rao)
>
> I’ll attach the infra checklist and a short cost estimate to reply.
>
> —Kimberly
> Principal Solutions, Redwood Inference
> kimberly@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0099

On Thu, 28 May 2026 at 09:03 AM, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com> wrote:
> From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
> To: Alex Green <alex.green@novacorp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
> Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:03:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: POC qualification follow-up: scope, owners, procurement path
>
> Alex / team — closing the loop after Kimberly’s notes. Updated action list and a slightly more detailed RACI below.
>
> Acceptance criteria (finalized)
> - Latency: p95 <= 200ms at 50 RPS sustained for 512-token queries (as measured by NovaCorp test harness).
> - Quality: embeddings recall >= 0.88 on the shared eval set (Monica to own scoring).
> - Infra: trial environment up and running with retention <= 7 days and audit log access for NovaCorp security.
>
> Final RACI (trial phase)
> - Responsible: NovaCorp app integration & test harness — Alex Green
> - Accountable: Monica Patel (trial acceptance and sign-off)
> - Consulted: Kimberly Park (infra choices, capacity)
> - Informed: Aditya Rao (commercial & timeline)
>
> Immediate next steps
> 1) Alex: send representative queries + procurement contact (procurement@novacorp.com) — target 2026-05-27 EOD.
> 2) Kimberly: confirm hosted vs dedicated and attach cost estimate + infra checklist — target 2026-05-28 EOD.
> 3) Monica: share runbook and open a 30-min kickoff for 2026-05-29 once infra is live.
> 4) Aditya: prepare 30-day evaluation SOW + trial order form and send to procurement — target 2026-05-28.
>
> I’ll loop in legal if procurement asks for any language changes, but the draft SOW will be intentionally short (trial scope + acceptance).
>
> Thanks all — let me know if anyone wants to change owners. If Alex confirms hosted today we’ll aim to have the environment standing by tomorrow morning.
>
> Cheers,
> Aditya Rao
> Business Development, Redwood Inference
> aditya@redwood.com
>
> Attachment stubs:
> - poc_scope.xlsx (worksheet: inventory, test cases, acceptance matrix)
> - redwood_security_summary.pdf (SOC2 highlights, retention defaults)
